captions.detailed: This 3D model features a heavy-duty bench vise designed for plumbing and workbench tasks. It consists of a dark blue fixed base, a sliding front jaw that moves linearly along the guide ways, and a secondary hinged pipe jaw below. A silver metallic lead screw assembly with a crossbar handle is positioned at the front to drive the clamping mechanism.
captions.instruction: Create a 3D model of a plumbing bench vise with a sliding front jaw, a rotating front screw handle, and a secondary hinged pipe jaw underneath the main body. Use a dark blue material for the cast body parts and a metallic silver for the screw, handle, and guide rods.
captions.factory: Construct the base body using a series of boolean-fused and filleted box primitives to form the fixed jaw and bottom mounting plate. Model the sliding jaw as a separate movable part using box extrusions. Create the lead screw and sliding handle using cylinder primitives, and set up a prismatic joint for the sliding jaw, a continuous joint for the rotating screw handle, and a revolute joint for the lower pipe jaw.
